{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# First, ensure we keep only one row per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now filter for control arm and moderate severity
control_moderate = df_dedup[(df_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (df_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Compute fraction of responders
n_total = len(control_moderate)
n_responded = control_moderate['responded'].sum()
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

print(f"Number of control-arm, moderate-severity patients (deduplicated): {n_total}")
print(f"Number of responders: {n_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
